1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de más de 3 m de altura, con hojas lanceoladas, inflorescencia panicular y flores amarillo-verdosas; es ornamental. Agavaceae, Agave missionum.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub exceeding 3 m in height, with lanceolate leaves, paniculate inflorescence and yellow-green flowers; it is ornamental. Agavaceae, Agave missionum.
